author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Closed coil with the flaring bell to the upper right, the inner tube across the coil and two valve pistons down to the rim, matching the reference layout; reads as a French horn at 48 in both themes. The pistons can look a little like teeth. A single-valve variant above the tube was rendered and read worse.
omissions: Valve keys (triangles) above the tube and the mouthpiece below the coil; no room 8 clear of the coil.
